description.narrative: UNDP TL implement together with the PDHJ the project "Capacity Development for the Provedoria for HR and Justice".Expected to contribute to improved inst capacity of the PDHJ;Improved capacity, strengthened HR mandate of the PDHJ,the effectiveness of the institution's outreach to the Timorese population, includ vulnerable groups by strengthening the district offices, cs and local level.

UNDP TL implementerar tillsammans med PDHJ projektet "Capacity Development for the Provedoria for HR and Justice". Förväntas bidra till förbättrad instkapacitet hos PDHJ;Förbättrad kapacitet, stärkt HR-mandat för PDHJ,effektiviteten i institutionens uppsökande verksamhet till Timoresisk befolkning, inklusive utsatta grupper genom att stärka distriktskontoren, cs och lokal nivå.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2014Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: The 2010 - 2014 Project outcome is "improved institutional Capacity of the Office for the Provedoria for Human Rights and Justice to serve the public institutions actions in line with human rights principles and standards" The project is structured around 3 outputs designed to deliver this outcome: 1a. PDHJ staff are knowledgeable about human rights concepts and understand how theese concepts are applied in their work 1b. PDHJ has a workforce skilled enought to implement the insitution's human rights mandate, including the ability to conduct legal analysis 2. PDHJ has effective and effecitive and efficient institutional structures and management systems 3. PDHJ has effective information and knowledge management systems
The project was implemented through a capacity development apporach, by supporting PDHJ staff and management to undertake work without performing line functions of the PDHJ. Some of the capacity development methodologies used included trainings, study tours, internships, mentoring and coaching, film sessions, discussions sessions, peer-to-peer learning, training of trainers, development of Standard Operational Policies and Procedures and development of knowledge products such as manuals, fact sheets, textbook etc. The Project was granted a no-cost extension until April 2015 to, among other things, cover PDHJ's institutional capacity assessment which took place early Januari 2015, to assist PDHJ to formulate its future programme.
Disbursements for PDHJ through UNDP did in 2014 amount to a total of 8,1MSEK.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
